_about: London (level_09): the per-probe switch of pack london-probes@2. In 0.31a2, 137 of London's 160 environment probes have use_parallax_correction (box-projected reflections: every room probe and the ten window probes; not the background-building and outdoor ones); patch 14 dropped the field. No London probe has smart_attenuation, so it carries the switch: these 137 get smart_attenuation = true, and on London's marked scenes the smart box programs of london-probes@2 draw them with the plain box falloff and the box-projected reflection. Every London project, the five day projects and the six rain/evening projects of pack london-weathers (merge #2213 first). Names: 0.31a2's day_2.
